name: @fracta-flow/retrieval-core
description: Deterministic, local, encrypted document retrieval — forked from rag-work's benchmarked retrieval pipeline (tokenize/expand, BM25-style rank, extractive snippet selection, AES-256-GCM + blind-index crypto primitives). Ported for reuse outside rag-work's single-workspace Next.js/Postgres deployment; the ranking/text-search logic is unmodified, the crypto layer is parameterized (no ambient key state) so a host app owns its own key custody.
